children.value:
yadi svayaṃ tathā na syātkathamanyāṃstathā
kuryāditi

kāminyo jarājīrṇakalevaraṃ sarvaṃ puruṣaṃ
karabhaṃ uṣṭraṃ yathā tathā paśyanti
eṣā uktalakṣaṇā aparāpi jarā ceto dahatīti saṃbandhaḥ

rogalakṣaṇenorageṇākīrṇā grastā yāvadrauti
roditi tāvanmaraṇakauśikaḥ kuto'pyāgata eva dṛśyata iti saṃbandhaḥ

gṛdhrī āmiṣamiva naraṃ tarasā vegena
nigaraṇāyaivādatta ityanvayaḥ

sā hi sītkārādi kārayati śarīraṃ tarupallavaṃ ca
pāṃsudhvastaṃ kṛtvā vidārayatyevaṃ jarāpi

vātakāsau rogau tāveva kumudvatīṃ kumudalatāṃ saṃrabdhaṃ sodyogaṃ
vikāsayati
jaraiva kṣāro lavaṇādicūrṇaṃ tena vidhūsaramupaskṛtamiti yāvat

yauvanamevākhanati viṣayabilamityākhustaṃ bhuṅkte tathā śarīrābhiṣasya
gardhinī bhakṣaṇecchuḥ
adrikoṭare duṣpraveśe parvatavivare'pi ye dhairyeṇa praviṣṭāḥ

gandhayati rāgādibhirvāsayati cittaṃ sabhāṃ
ceti gandho viṣayabhogaḥ kastūryādigandhadravyaṃ ca tasya kuṭhyāṃ
āśrayabhūtāyāṃ dehayaṣṭyāṃ śirogatā jarānāmnī cāmaraśrīrvirājate
